svg.text: HANG CURVE R3 ABOUT THE TOP CORNER,
DROP SLOT OPEN AT THE TOP:
THE LID DROPS IN FROM ABOVE
THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · DIMENSIONS IN INCHES · GENERAL TOL ±1/32 (MEASURE PLY AND PLATE BEFORE CUTTING) · GENERATED FROM SOLIDCRAFT DESIGN, DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
THE SECOND SET IS THE SAME PARTS FLIPPED OVER.
SLOTS 0.381 WIDE (3/8 PIN + 0.15 mm), CENTRED 3/4 FROM THE
FRONT AND AFT EDGES. TRACKS 3 APART.
OPEN: 10 HOLES IN THE NARROW STRIPS (BEHIND THE DROP
SLOT, ABOVE THE UPPER TRACK) LEAVE 0.126 EACH SIDE
